title: Quests, the shop, and your profile

steps.title: Today's quests
steps.body: Daily, weekly, and monthly. They rotate at midnight UTC and they're the same for everyone — nobody is being handed an easier set.

steps.title: Claim one
steps.body: Completed quests aren't paid automatically — you claim them. If nothing is claimable right now, skip this step; you'll have one tomorrow.

steps.title: Achievements
steps.body: One-off, permanent, and mostly hidden until you trigger them. They're for the things nobody would set as a goal but everyone appreciates — like being first to review someone's change request.

steps.title: Go to the shop
steps.body: This is where doubloons actually go.

steps.title: Your doubloons
steps.body: Separate from XP. Spending these never costs you rank — XP only ever goes up.

steps.title: Cosmetics only
steps.body: Frames, name styles, effects. Deliberately nothing functional — the moment doubloons buy capability, the reward system starts distorting how people pick their work.

steps.title: Your rank
steps.body: Nestling through Celestial, 0 to 21,000 XP. Worth being clear about: rank is recognition, not permission. It unlocks nothing — a Nestling and a Celestial with the same role can do exactly the same things.
